manifest_contract.shape: One Lab is one normal task under its owning CTRL.
manifest_contract.delegation: The owning CTRL handles delegation. The Lab chooses the roles and methods needed for its goal.
manifest_contract.custom: A CTRL may name a new Lab for any focused area and apply this same manifest shape.

labs.name: Product Lab
labs.summary: Own the product and its viability.
labs.outcome: One viable product direction with user value, priorities, pricing, and financial constraints aligned.
guide: Frame the user value, business goal, and constraints.
Prioritize the smallest viable product direction.
Review evidence, economics, and the next decision.

labs.name: Research Lab
labs.summary: Turn research, data, and analytics into insight.
labs.outcome: One sourced or measured finding that changes a decision.
guide: Frame the question, metric, and evidence standard.
Research or analyze the smallest useful data set.
Return the finding that changes the build.

labs.name: Design Lab
labs.outcome: One selected experience with responsive and accessibility proof.
guide: Frame the user outcome and fixed constraints.
Explore and compare focused candidates.
Promote one proven experience.

labs.name: Build Lab
labs.outcome: One integrated increment across architecture, code, integrations, or automation with focused proof.
guide: Frame the increment and acceptance proof.
Build in small inspectable blocks.
Integrate the accepted result.

labs.name: Test Lab
labs.summary: Prove it works and holds up.
labs.outcome: One accepted result with quality, reliability, security, and recovery evidence.
guide: Frame the user contract, risks, and acceptance proof.
Test representative, hostile, and recovery paths.
Accept the result or return precise corrections.

labs.name: Content Lab
labs.outcome: One publishable content system or campaign.
guide: Frame the audience and intended action.
Create and compare focused versions.
Promote one publishable result.

labs.name: Growth Lab
labs.outcome: One measured keep, change, or stop decision.
guide: Frame the behavior and success signal.
Run the smallest measurable experiment.
Keep, change, or stop from evidence.

labs.name: Ops Lab
labs.outcome: One dependable delivery path with monitoring and recovery.
guide: Frame the delivery target and safe operating boundary.
Connect, automate, launch, and observe the smallest complete path.
Verify the live result and recovery route.
